name: agent_telematic_filing
_description: Fase B.4 plan Opus: Tramitador Digital. Empaqueta expediente para sede electronica. Lee municipal_templates + entregables (iee_reports, rcd_studies). Devuelve checklist + estructura ZIP. PRINCIPIO INMUTABLE Opus #7: NUNCA presenta - el tecnico firma y sube manualmente.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok),
p AS (
  SELECT projects.id AS project_id, projects.name, projects.project_type, projects.location_city, projects.location_province
  FROM projects, ctx WHERE projects.id = $4::uuid LIMIT 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT mt.* FROM municipal_templates mt, p
  WHERE LOWER(mt.municipio) = LOWER(COALESCE($5, p.location_city))
    AND mt.tipo_tramite = $6
  LIMIT 1
),
iee AS (
  SELECT iee_reports.id AS iee_id, iee_reports.calificacion_global, iee_reports.approved_at
  FROM iee_reports, p
  WHERE iee_reports.project_id = p.project_id
  ORDER BY iee_reports.approved_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
rcd AS (
  SELECT rcd_studies.id AS rcd_id, rcd_studies.total_toneladas, rcd_studies.approved_at
  FROM rcd_studies, p
  WHERE rcd_studies.project_id = p.project_id
  ORDER BY rcd_studies.approved_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT project_id FROM p) AS project_id,
  (SELECT name FROM p) AS project_name,
  (SELECT project_type FROM p) AS project_type,
  (SELECT location_city FROM p) AS project_city,
  (SELECT location_province FROM p) AS project_province,
  (SELECT row_to_json(m) FROM m) AS municipal_template,
  (SELECT row_to_json(iee) FROM iee) AS iee_data,
  (SELECT row_to_json(rcd) FROM rcd) AS rcd_data

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_telematic_filing', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

UPDATE agent_executions
SET status = 'completed',
    finished_at = now(),
    output = $2::jsonb,
    metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb
WHERE id = $1::uuid
